A tiny source-pinned entry validates the selected cached pip RECORD payload and origin/version, then executes unchanged pip via runpy with explicit --isolated/offline/hash-required flags and the owned prefix. unused_global_site_packages: Excluded from the no-site base runtime census, with exact raw link/target spelling recorded before/after; global payloads are not copied or loaded.

base_namespace_closure: Complete physical base/stdlib directory, regular-file and lexical-symlink membership (including empty directories) checked before/after, excluding only recorded unused global site subtrees.
selected_native_closure: All selected cached Mach-O files plus base native files are scanned by pinned otool; dependency closure permits only selected cached members, pinned external Homebrew physical files or explicitly recorded Darwin shared-cache identities. LC_ID self identity is separate.
overall_wall_scope: 600-second passing completed-wall postcheck through input and output accounting; final receipt write is outside the measured postcheck. No enforced OS quota or full descendant RSS claim.
native_architecture: Both pinned otool load-name and load-command reads select -arch arm64. Exact binary headers are validated separately from dependency rows, including universal payloads.
loader_environment_admission: Preparation and launch refuse any present DYLD_* / LD_PRELOAD / LD_LIBRARY_PATH / _PYTHON_HOST_PLATFORM / __PYVENV_LAUNCHER__ key before subprocess/tool invocation, including empty values. Receipt lists only forbidden key names and no values. Child environment clears these keys as defense after refusal.
